title: kb-sprint run --headless records gates and stops after K landed items
goal: The kb-sprint skill's run section gains a headless path for 'run SP --headless --landed K', the prompt autopilot.py runner start sends: it never calls AskUserQuestion; a choice the operator must make is recorded as a gate with its options and recommendation (backlog.py gate add), its items wait and the run goes on with the rest; a provisional gate takes its recommendation (answer --provisional); it stops after K items landed or when next has nothing ready, and its last message names the exit cause the runner records (landed-limit, sprint-done or blocked); a relaunched run starts from horizon and next as the interactive loop does, so it continues where the last one stopped. kb/_self/backlog.md's Sprints section names the runner (autopilot.py runner start and runner-status) in one paragraph. A test autopilot_runner_skill_headless checks that the prompt runner start sends names a section the skill holds and that the headless section names no AskUserQuestion call. AGENTS.md stays under its 4 KB cap: no line is added there unless one is removed.

gates.question: Which exit cause does a headless run name when only items whose code/<id> merge request has not merged remain?
options: blocked: the item waits on a request, so nothing is ready
sprint-done: the run's own work is finished
gates.recommendation: blocked: the item waits on a request, so nothing is ready
gates.answer: blocked: the item waits on a request, so nothing is ready

gates.question: Does a headless run work the sprint's review story?
options: No: the review story is the operator's, and a run with only it left ends sprint-done
Yes: the run claims and works the review story like any item
gates.recommendation: No: the review story is the operator's, and a run with only it left ends sprint-done
gates.answer: No: the review story is the operator's, and a run with only it left ends sprint-done
